name: Duet Sand
description: Strike twice in rhythm with sand in each hand so the second blow rides the first.

name: Mirror Grain
description: Hold matching films of grain before and behind the body so a strike meets a film either way.

name: Pair Skid
description: Skid on two parallel lines of sand and halt abruptly beside the foe.

name: Echoing Dust
description: Throw dust that echoes the user's outline so foes strike at the wrong copy.

name: Matching Wave
description: Send two waves of sand of equal height from each hand to meet over the target.

name: Duet Binding
description: Wind two ropes of sand around the target's arms and legs and draw each taut.

name: Mirror Turn
description: Turn aside a blow on a mirrored film of grain and return half its force to the striker.

name: Twofold Burial
description: Bury the target twice over with sand from either side until both banks meet over the chest.

name: Sandduet Lance
description: Thrust two lances of sand along the same line so the second drives through the hole of the first.

name: Mirror Crush
description: Raise mirrored dunes across the field and roll them inward until nothing between them can stand.

name: Twinned Collapse
description: Raise two great sand banks at once and let them collapse together on the school's chosen mark.

name: Hawk Sand
description: Strike with fingers hooked like talons and sand packed between each knuckle.

name: Cry Dust
description: Loose a sharp cry that shakes dust from the air into the foe's ears and eyes.

name: Bowl Skid
description: Skid down a shallow bowl of sand and out the other side a long pace on.

name: Sand Crescent
description: Sweep a crescent of sand out of the basin to rake a front of foes.

name: Sandtalon Guard
description: Catch a blow on crossed talons of sand and twist it away from the body.

name: Stooping Dust
description: Drop a stooping curtain of dust that hides the user's true line of attack.

name: Sand Crush
description: Bring the basin's whole sand down onto one point and crush the guard beneath it.

name: Sandhawk Fall
description: Fall upon a group in the shape of a hawk of sand that rakes the ground clear.

name: Sandhawk Cry
description: Cry out a great hawk call that bursts the sand around it and leaves all within it reeling.

name: Sandmaster Stoop
description: Drop from height in the school's founding stoop with the whole basin of sand behind one strike.

name: Azure Grain
description: Strike with a fist of blue-grey grain that rings against the target's guard.

name: Sovereign Cloak
description: Drape a cloak of ruled sand across the shoulders so it falls into place at every turn.

name: Azure Skid
description: Skid forward on a pale strip of sand that shoots out before each pace.

name: Sovereign Sense
description: Command the sand of the field to report every body that touches it.

name: Azure Sweep
description: Sweep a wide band of blue-grey sand across the front and knock aside what stands.

name: Sovereign Weight
description: Lay the weight of the realm's sand on a single foe until their stance bows.

name: Bluesand Binding
description: Bind the foe with blue sand that sets at the ruler's word.

name: Sovereign Turn
description: Turn a strike away with a commanding sweep of sand that bends it round the body.

name: Azure Burial
description: Order a drift of blue sand over the target until they stand buried to the chest.

name: Bluesand Needle
description: Draw the field's sand into a single needle that pierces the guard it is aimed at.

name: Crowned Dust
description: Raise a crown of dust above the user that strikes all foes near and shields the one beneath.

name: Sand Sovereign
description: Call the whole field of sand to the user's will and rule it as a sovereign over a realm.

name: Core Grain
description: Strike with a grain drawn from the Core that lands harder than its size allows.

name: Glass Sheath
description: Sheath the torso in fused sand with a glassy gloss that sheds light blows.

name: Fine Pour
description: Pour the body forward along a thin stream of sand and reform a pace on.

name: Core Pour
description: Pour sand from the Core in a broad stream across a group of foes.

name: Horizon Dust
description: Raise dust to the horizon line so foes lose all sense of near and far.

name: Core Counter
description: Meet a strike with a spin of Core sand that returns the force to the striker.

name: Core Collapse
description: Let a vault of Core sand fall onto a group and bury the ground under them.

name: Sandglass Lance
description: Drive a lance of poured sand through a guard at the narrow point of the glass.

name: Horizon Sandglass
description: Take a great blow into the glass of the Core and pour it back across the horizon as sand.

name: Sandhorizon Collapse
description: Pour the Core's sand across two horizons at once so the field collapses beneath it.

name: Bearer Palm
description: Strike with a palm carrying the weight of a full load of sand.

name: Sandbearer Guard
description: Carry a sack of sand on the shoulders that takes every blow as part of the load.

name: Bearer Step
description: Plod on in short steady paces that never slow however heavy the load.

name: Burdened Sand
description: Load the target with a burden of sand that makes every step a labor.

name: Bearer Binding
description: Tie the target down with straps of packed sand drawn from the carried load.

name: Sandbearer Wave
description: Tip the load forward in a heavy wave that slides over a row of foes.

name: Burden Turn
description: Turn the load on the shoulders to slide a striking blow off along the back.

name: Sandbearer Oath
description: Swear to carry the load to its end and spill it upon any who bar the road.

name: Burden Lance
description: Drive the whole load through a single narrow point of the guard.

name: Absorbing Burden
description: Take a blow into the carried load and add its weight to the sand on the shoulders.

name: Plateau Burden
description: Lay the whole sandbearer's load across the field in the school's founding spill.

name: Windsworn Dust
description: Strike with a fist of dust sworn to the wind that rides each blow on a push.

name: Dust Pledge
description: Hold a pledged shell of dust close to the body that gives only to the user's will.

name: Pledge Skid
description: Skid forward on a pledged line of sand toward the exact point named.

name: Pledged Veil
description: Hang a pledged veil of dust that only the sworn can see through.

name: Windsworn Wave
description: Drive a wave of dust before a swift push across the front of the foes.

name: Pledgesand Guard
description: Turn a strike on the pledge-line with a sweep of sand that bends its path.

name: Windsworn Needle
description: Loose a needle of sworn dust along the wind that pierces a shield in its path.

name: Pledge Fall
description: Call down a fall of sworn dust on those who stand against the pledge.

name: Windsworn Seal
description: Seal the target's qi with dust sworn to the wind so it cannot leave their body.

name: Windsworn Scour
description: Scour the whole field with sworn dust until only those faithful to the pledge remain unharmed.

name: Dustfield Palm
description: Strike with a palm where the dustfield thickens and hardens into a single hard pad.

name: Dustfield Cloak
description: Draw the nearest dust of the field into a cloak that moves with every turn.

name: Dust Skid
description: Skid over the field on dust that gathers and thins as the body passes.

name: Dustfield Reader
description: Read the whole field from the gaps that moving bodies leave in the dust.

name: Dustfield Sweep
description: Sweep the dustfield across the foes in one flat pass that scours their feet.

name: Dustfield Weight
description: Gather the field's dust over a single foe until their head and arms sag.

name: Dustfield Binding
description: Wind the dustfield around the target's limbs until it sets like clay.

name: Dustfield Turn
description: Spin the dust before the body to turn a strike off its line.

name: Dustfield Burial
description: Pile the field's dust over a foe in one push until it covers them to the neck.

name: Dustfield Lance
description: Gather the field into a lance of dust that goes through shield and armor.

name: Dustfield Vanishing
description: Melt into the dustfield and reappear at its far edge in a single blink.

name: Open Dustfield
description: Spread the dustfield to the edge of sight in the school's founding act and wear all within it.

name: Oathcore Grain
description: Strike with a grain sworn to the Core that carries its weight into the blow.

name: Oathcore Shell
description: Close a shell of sand sworn to the Core around the body and keep it held.

name: Oathcore Skid
description: Skid out on a path of sand that returns to the Core when the step ends.

name: Oathcore Wave
description: Send a wave of oath-bound sand from the Core across the front.

name: Oathcore Bind
description: Bind the target with sand sworn to hold until the Core releases it.

name: Oathcore Turn
description: Spin the sworn sand about the Core to turn a blow into empty air.

name: Oathcore Needle
description: Loose a needle of Core-sworn sand that pierces any guard it was aimed to break.

name: Oathcore Collapse
description: Collapse a dome of sworn sand upon a group and press them to the ground.

name: Oathcore Absorb
description: Draw a heavy blow into the sworn sand of the Core and keep it as weight.

name: Oathcore Burst
description: Loose the Core's oath in one great burst of sand that wears the wind and all it carries.
